description: The pin status of an issue panel (added by a Forge app) for a single project.

error.description: The reason the pin status could not be read for the project. Null if the pin status was read successfully.

pinned.description: Whether the issue panel is currently pinned to the project.

pinnedAt.description: The time the issue panel was pinned to the project, in epoch milliseconds.

projectIdOrKey.description: The project ID or key supplied in the request.
